This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Timberdoodle arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Timberdoodle has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to balk and thrash while on leash. This behavior is not easily redirectable. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Timberdoodle
